mapper.select: SELECT achievement_id AS "achievementId", evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", owner_user_id AS "ownerUserId", organization_code AS "organizationCode", management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", guidance_start_date AS "guidanceStartDate", guidance_end_date AS "guidanceEndDate", student_count AS "studentCount", certification_status AS "certificationStatus", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM student_guidance_achievements WHERE achievement_id=#{achievementId} AND deleted_yn='N'
SELECT student_name AS "studentName", student_detail_jsonb AS "detail" FROM student_guidance_students WHERE achievement_id=#{achievementId} ORDER BY student_guidance_student_id

SELECT achievement_id FROM student_guidance_achievements WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear} AND management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode} AND guidance_start_date=#{request.guidanceStartDate} AND guidance_end_date=#{request.guidanceEndDate} AND deleted_yn='N' ORDER BY achievement_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE student_guidance_achievements SET evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear},organization_code=#{request.organizationCode},management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode},guidance_start_date=#{request.guidanceStartDate},guidance_end_date=#{request.guidanceEndDate},student_count=#{request.students.size},achievement_detail=COALESCE(CAST(#{request.achievementDetail,typeHandler=kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.achievement.AchievementDetailJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb),'{}'::jsonb),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} AND deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_guidance_students (achievement_id,student_name,student_detail_jsonb,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{achievementId},#{student.studentName},COALESCE(CAST(#{student.detail,typeHandler=kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.achievement.AchievementDetailJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb),'{}'::jsonb),#{userId},#{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM excel_upload_templates WHERE template_id='B77-STUDENT-GUIDANCE-V1' AND business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND status='ACTIVE' AND system_use_yn='Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status=#{status} WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id,upload_id,row_number,row_payload,validation_status) VALUES (#{stagingId},#{uploadId},#{rowNumber},CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb),#{status})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors (error_id,upload_id,row_number,column_name,input_value,error_code,error_reason,correction_guide) VALUES (#{errorId},#{uploadId},#{error.rowNumber},#{error.columnName},NULL,#{error.errorCode},#{error.errorReason},'양식의 해당 열을 수정한 뒤 다시 검증하세요.')

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories (upload_id,total_count,success_count,error_count,excluded_count,saved_count,processing_time_millis,processor_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId},#{total},#{success},#{errors},0,#{saved},0,#{userId}) ON CONFLICT (upload_id) DO UPDATE SET total_count=EXCLUDED.total_count,success_count=EXCLUDED.success_count,error_count=EXCLUDED.error_count,saved_count=EXCLUDED.saved_count,processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,processor_user_id=EXCLUDED.processor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND status!='DELETED'
SELECT count(*) FROM excel_upload_files WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND uploader_user_id=#{userId} AND status!='DELETED'
SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings WHERE evaluation_year=#{evaluationYear} AND management_item_code=#{managementItemCode} AND active_yn='Y'
SELECT row_payload::text FROM excel_upload_staging_rows WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND validation_status='NORMAL' ORDER BY row_number
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status='COMMITTED' WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND validation_status='VALIDATED'
mapper.select: SELECT row_number AS "rowNumber",column_name AS "columnName",error_code AS "errorCode",error_reason AS "errorReason" FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND status!='DELETED' ORDER BY row_number,column_name

SELECT h.upload_id AS "uploadId",f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName",f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId",h.total_count AS "totalCount",h.success_count AS "successCount",h.error_count AS "errorCount",h.saved_count AS "savedCount",h.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM excel_upload_histories h JOIN excel_upload_files f ON f.upload_id=h.upload_id WHERE f.business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND f.uploader_user_id=#{uploaderUserId} AND h.status!='DELETED' ORDER BY h.processed_at DESC
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE employee_no=#{employeeNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM student_guidance_achievements a JOIN student_guidance_students s ON s.achievement_id=a.achievement_id WHERE a.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND a.guidance_start_date=#{guidanceStartDate} AND a.guidance_end_date=#{guidanceEndDate} AND s.student_name=#{studentName} AND a.deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO student_guidance_achievements (evaluation_year,owner_user_id,organization_code,management_item_code,guidance_start_date,guidance_end_date,student_count,achievement_detail,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{evaluationYear},#{ownerUserId},#{organizationCode},#{managementItemCode},#{guidanceStartDate},#{guidanceEndDate},1,'{}'::jsonb,#{userId},#{userId}) RETURNING achievement_id) INSERT INTO student_guidance_students (achievement_id,student_name,student_detail_jsonb,created_by,updated_by) SELECT achievement_id,#{studentName},'{}'::jsonb,#{userId},#{userId} FROM inserted
